info.name: RS CAB - Complete API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for RS CAB ride-hailing platform. Base URL: https://backend.real-support.com/api

All admin endpoints require Bearer token authentication. Login via POST /api/admin/adminUsers/login to get your token.
